CalibrationPair.description: One blinded calibration pair against the same retained execution and criterion.

maximumScoreDifference.description: Maximum absolute normalized score disagreement for a pair.

minimumAgreement.description: Minimum required fraction of agreeing pairs.

CalibrationRequest.description: Predeclared calibration rule and exact sample identities.

reason.description: Human explanation retained with the review task.

CaptureIncidentRequest.description: Incident capture names a draft and its observed revision; it cannot replace frozen cases or create a reference answer.

ComparisonCandidate.description: Exact candidate configuration represented in a saved comparison.

eligibleCases.description: Cases with complete repeat evidence and verified candidate provenance.

scoredCases.description: Cases with a score for each repeat.

unreconciledCases.description: Cases with duplicate, conflicting or unverified evidence.

mean.description: Mean of scored case means, or null when none are scored.

matchedMean.description: Mean over the shared scored cases, or null when no cases match.

ComparisonCandidateMetric.description: Equal-case weighted candidate results and visible coverage.

status.description: Scored, Pending, NonScore, Unreconciled or browser-projected Withheld.

score.description: Within-case mean, only when every expected repeat is scored.

outcomes.description: Distinct observed assessment outcomes, including failures and non-scores.

ComparisonCase.description: One frozen case outcome under a candidate and criterion.

commonCaseIds.description: Cases scored for every represented candidate.

ComparisonCriterion.description: Criterion results under one frozen benchmark and dataset.

status.description: Unknown until the rule is evaluated.

ComparisonGuardrail.description: A guardrail whose evaluation is not yet supported.

baselineAmbiguous.description: Whether that ID names more than one exact candidate configuration.

candidates.description: Configurations represented by selected assessment IDs.

guardrails.description: Frozen rules with unknown evaluation status.

independentAcceptanceEligible.description: Current exposure status for an acceptance dataset; null for other purposes.

holdoutWithheld.description: Whether per-case evidence was withheld by the browser projection.

primaryCriterionId.description: Headline metric pinned by the frozen benchmark; never inferred from the first available score.

ComparisonReport.description: Read-only exact-protocol comparison; it makes no causal or winner claim.

exposedCaseIds.description: Cases whose source families have been revealed or used for tuning.

independentAcceptanceEligible.description: Whether this acceptance set has no recorded source-family exposure.

DatasetExposure.description: Exposure is separate from frozen dataset content so later human reveals cannot rewrite an earlier protocol.

assessmentJobId.description: Optional reassessment run that explicitly retained this execution.

DeterministicAssessmentRequest.description: Identifies the stored execution and frozen criterion to assess.

purpose.description: Production, Shadow, or Unknown; role and experiment identifiers cannot establish origin.

buildId.description: Registered build reported by the authenticated host.

outputRef.description: Exact original command or sealed aggregate reference, when stored.

input.description: Authorized frozen typed input, or absent when not retained.

sourceFamilyId.description: Stable document/source lineage, required for curation.

oneOf.description: Captured trace anchor, independent of span availability.

caseElapsedSeconds.description: Actual host-captured case elapsed, never a sum of attempts.

attempts.description: Normalized observations, not a durable send journal.

ExecutionObservation.description: Trusted application report of an original execution; retained input is explicit and must follow the host capture policy.

assessmentJobId.description: Optional reassessment run retaining this execution.

HumanAssessmentRequest.description: Human rubric assessment of a retained exact execution.

IncidentCapture.description: Draft evidence and owned task produced by capture; acceptance remains a separate review.

assessmentJobId.description: Optional reassessment that retains this output.

calibrationId.description: Admitted matching calibration for non-calibration datasets.

JudgeEvaluationRequest.description: Explicitly approved judge work for a retained output under a frozen protocol.

state.description: Lifecycle state, separate from execution or telemetry status.

contentHash.description: Digest of the exact normalized stored body.

body.description: Detached immutable content for this revision.

ManagementResource.description: Persisted management artifact. Its JSON body is governed by a module's validation and freeze rules.

attemptId.description: Original provider-attempt identity, used once for accounting.

durationSeconds.description: Captured attempt timing, separate from case elapsed.

ObservedAttempt.description: Normalized host observation; its presence is evidence, while its absence never proves that no provider send occurred.

state.description: Unknown without fresh matching reports; otherwise ReportingHostsOnly.

hosts.description: Known reports, including stale and mismatched hosts.

PublicationAdoption.description: Bounded reporting-host view; it never claims fleet-wide adoption without an inventory.

targetId.description: Server target whose manual-decision policy applies.

action.description: Activate, ChangeAllocation, ChangeControl, Rollback, or RestoreConfiguredDefaults.

verdict.description: Manual Pass, Fail, or Inconclusive; never an automated test claim.

comparisonId.description: Immutable comparison with pinned benchmark and candidate evidence.

evidencePublicationId.description: For restore-defaults only, the old publication investigated by the report.

PublicationDecisionRequest.description: Manual decision input. The server supplies the author and validates linked evidence.

buildId.description: Exact registered build running on the reporting host.

publicationRevision.description: Observed publication revision, or null when unknown.

publicationHash.description: Observed content hash, or null with unknown revision.

sequence.description: Monotonic per authenticated host and target; persist across restarts.

PublicationHostReport.description: Host-reported adoption. Authenticated subject supplies host identity; these reports are not deployment proof.

PublicationHostStatus.description: Per-host freshness and exact adoption evidence.

wholePartitionReplacementReviewed.description: Acknowledges that omitted commands use configured defaults.

PublicationReviewRequest.description: Explicit review confirmation; reads the actual target before saving a delivery intent.

qualified.description: Passed an explicit real-provider contract suite.

PublicationTargetCapabilities.description: Truthful adapter capability, independent of the management database provider.

allowManualDecisions.description: Explicit policy permitting an authored decision over pinned evidence.

PublicationTargetProfile.description: Server-owned binding metadata. No connection string or credential reference is exposed.

targets.description: Configured targets in the authorized scope.

fileDevelopment.description: File source has no supported CAS writer.

PublicationTargetsView.description: Explicitly configured targets; absence means publishing is unconfigured.

PublicationTargetView.description: Typed target capability data; credential references stay in server configuration.

decision.description: Reject or NeedsEvidence; accepted draft edits need adjudication support.

datasetDraftId.description: Explicit destination for a future accepted reference.

ReviewDecision.description: A reviewer decision with an explanation and optional draft destination.

SaveComparisonRequest.description: Immutable references used to inspect a comparison under one frozen protocol.

id.description: Optional immutable build identity during registration.

SaveResource.description: Input to an explicit draft transition; it is never an implicit publish or model launch.

StoredAsset.description: Scoped immutable asset identity, independent of expiring trace storage.

TraceAnchor.description: Portable trace identifiers used as a link, not an authorization source.

application.description: Application namespace authorized by the host.

key.description: Unambiguous storage key; separators inside names cannot merge scopes.

WorkspaceScope.description: Explicit application, deployment and data boundary; identifiers do not grant access.
